summary.text:
LG INR21700 M50, 130 km/h 90%→10%, then 0.7C charge to 80% (96s35p), ambient 35 degC
Limits: T_peak <= 45 degC, in-cell dT <= 5 degC, ready again within 180 min
39 designs, 24 feasible, 3 on the trade-off front
NOTE: bottom plates are solved in 2D (radius x height). A chiller pulling a hot-soaked pack down through its base opens large top-to-bottom gradients while it does so.
NOTE: liquid pump power covers the whole loop (4.7 mW/cell at most) and the radiator fan is charged at 3 % of the heat it rejects; chiller idle losses are not included.
Lightest       air 0.3 g/s, no filler: T_peak 40.4 degC, +1.8% mass, aux 1.91% of energy, recovery 18 min, 56% capacity after 8 yr
Lowest energy  ribbon 0.02 g/s, 3.5 mm gap, RT42: T_peak 40.3 degC, +19.9% mass, aux 0.09% of energy, recovery 86 min, 56% capacity after 8 yr
Balanced       ribbon 0.05 g/s, 3.5 mm gap, no filler: T_peak 39.2 degC, +7.2% mass, aux 0.14% of energy, recovery 12 min, 56% capacity after 8 yr
Not picked     air 0.15 g/s, no filler: +1.8% mass, aux 0.30%, but fails (hot) at worst-case R0 = 43 mOhm (peak 45.6 degC)
Not picked     ribbon 0.02 g/s, 3.5 mm gap, no filler: +7.2% mass, aux 0.09%, but fails (hot) at worst-case R0 = 43 mOhm (peak 45.1 degC)
Not picked     bottom 0.02 g/s, RT42: +18.2% mass, aux 0.09%, but fails (hot) at worst-case R0 = 43 mOhm (peak 45.2 degC)

labels.mass_axis: Mass added per cell (filler + cooling hardware), % of cell mass
labels.energy_axis: Fan, pump and chiller energy, % of energy moved by the cell
